meta_rows: Nitrogen dioxide; land use regression land use regression (LUR) estimate for annual mean air pollution concentration (ug/m3) in 1991 - at age 43 years

Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) maps were modelled based on a land use regression (LUR) model. The NO2 map is based on input data from the Automatic Urban and Rural Network (AURN), Defra. For details of the models see references Gulliver et al, 2011 (for BS & SO2) and Gulliver et al, 2013 (for NO2). Calculated for 1991 based on the closest year for the cohort 1989.
